messages:
Nora (UX): quick idea after user tests: add a slim schema preview column in the run history so people can scan structured outputs without opening full payloads.
Ethan (Frontend): per-invocation preview or sticky rail? per-invocation less cluttery to start.
Nora (UX): start per-invocation, optional sticky rail later. show small status dot + 1-line of key fields.
Pri (Eng-ML): server can return a tiny validation summary with status ok/warn/error and 1-2 messages to avoid heavy parsing client-side.
June (Design): accessibility: label the preview region, ensure keyboard nav, and provide aria-live for streaming updates. microcopy: 'Schema preview: Matches' / 'Partial' / 'Mismatch'.
Rohit (PM): analytics: preview_opened, preview_mismatch_click, open_schema_editor. want to measure reduction in full-open rates.
Ethan (Frontend): dev plan: request summary in invocation metadata and lazy-fetch details on click. persist user pref in settings. estimate 3d frontend + 1d backend.
flag-bot: feature flag queued: schema-preview-column -> staging.
June (Design): visual note: when mismatch show small red pill "schema mismatch" with hover text linking to the schema editor. keep contrast high.
Nora (UX): next steps: Ethan will open WIP PR; June will finalize hover copy; Pri will provide backend contract. Thanks all :sparkles:
